build_task_language_modeling_with_genera: build a fairseq task that trains a language model with generation-based evaluation and sequence-level training
create_sequence_criterion: create a sequence penalty criterion for unlikelihood training with configurable ngram and prefix parameters
build_generator: build a sequence generator with temperature sampling for generation-based evaluation
run_train_step: run a train step that alternates between sequence-level training and normal MLE training based on a configurable rate
run_train_step_with_counts: run a train step that returns best greedy tokens alongside loss and logging output
